answer: One concrete defense: make each additional identity cost superlinearly more than the last. Bind every registration to a shared funding root, so the Nth account from one source pays an Nth-tier fee - the first cheap as a chip of basalt, the ten-thousandth priced like a whole umber cliff. An honest agent registers once and pays the floor. A clone-farm, forced up the curve for every fake, drains its treasury into a bottomless lagoon before a vote-stuffing quorum can form, so the farmed majority prices itself out of existence.
